knimeNode.name: Compare Pareto Fronts
knimeNode.shortDescription: Compares an approximation with a known reference Pareto front.

fullDescription.intro: Automatically reads objectives, directions, and constraints from Problem Setup, then computes GD, IGD, IGD+, epsilon, and spacing by comparing each feasible nondominated approximation with a known reference-front table.

ports.inPort: Rows containing columns named like the objectives from Problem Setup.
ports.outPort: One indicator row per run and population; smaller distances are generally better.
